up: Please retrieve the first 1000 rows of IC50 activity measurements that have pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3775 (M-phase inducer phosphatase 1). The target is defined as a SINGLE PROTEIN from Homo sapiens. For each qualifying activity row, provide the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (from assays.chembl_id), target type (from target_dictionary.target_type), target tax_id (from target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (from activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (from activities.pchembl_value). Only include rows where standard_relation is exactly '=', pchembl_value is not null, and standard_type is 'IC50'. The data must be sourced by joining activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3775', target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', and target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Sort the results first by molecule ChEMBL ID (ascending), then by assay ChEMBL ID (ascending). Return at most 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type AS target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id AS target_tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, activities.standard_type AS standard_type, activities.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value FROM activities JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE activities.standard_type = 'IC50' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3775' AND target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens' ORDER BY molecule_dictionary.chembl_id ASC, assays.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000
